even in the outlying areas they sought to read thus [the Ten Commandments with the Shema]
but they had already abolished them [the daily reading of the Ten Commandments] because of the grievance of the heretics
Rabba bar bar Chana thought to institute [the reading of the Ten Commandments] in Sura
Ameimar thought to institute [the reading of the Ten Commandments] in Nehardea
